//: THE UNCLASSIFIED-FIELD LEDGER — named, shrink-only, read by check-derived-classification (K1b).
Specified by BIM30-READINESS-GATES.md §3.20 ("Ratchet: the unclassified-field list, named and
shrink-only") and governed by ADR-0319. C70 §7's exit condition for this gate is "every field
carries its ADR-0319 class and the class is ENFORCED, not documented" — which is reached when
this list is EMPTY and the class-1 population acquires an enforcement mechanism (see the
SECOND EXIT CONDITION below, which this list alone does not cover).
WHAT LANDS HERE: a field that is DERIVED-SHAPED — an audit, counter, or authorship field, i.e.
the population ADR-0319 exists to legislate — and that carries NO class under either enforced
predicate. Authored geometric/parametric fields do NOT belong here: ADR-0319 §1 makes class 1
the DEFAULT ("every authored geometric and parametric field" is AUTHORITATIVE, byte-for-byte,
needing no list because it needs no tolerance). A ledger that enumerated `wall.height` would
invert the ADR — turning a default-deny contract into a registry, and a registry that must
list every authored field is one somebody eventually maintains by adding whatever is failing.
NOT A TOLERANCE LIST. Nothing here is excused and nothing here is excluded from any
comparator. An entry means only: THIS FIELD HAS NO RULE YET, and the fact is named instead of
being absent. The persistence comparator still compares `metadata.createdBy` in full.
FIRST MEASURED READING — 2026-08-12, `npx tsx gates/check-derived-classification.ts`:
field universe    482 field paths across 27 kinds, enumerated from the LIVE Zod registry
derived-shaped     5 fields, of which 4 CLASSIFIED and 1 UNCLASSIFIED
classified         metadata.createdAt (§3) · metadata.modifiedAt (§3) ·
metadata.version (§2) · _renderVersion (§2)
unclassified       metadata.createdBy   <- the single entry below
─── WHY metadata.createdBy IS HERE, AND WHY IT IS NOT A ONE-LINE FIX ────────────────────────
It is declared on the SHARED `Metadata` primitive at
packages/schemas/src/base/primitives.ts:43 (`createdBy: z.string().default('system')`), so it
is carried by all 27 element kinds — every persisted element in PRYZM has one. It is actively
written with meaningful, DIFFERING values ('ai' in ViewAuthoringIntentMapper.ts:120 and :323,
'user' in AddAssetCatalogEntryCommand.ts:85, command names in CreateBeamCommand.ts:225), so it
is neither dead nor constant.
ADR-0319 names it in NONE of its three classes. The ADR enumerates `createdAt`/`modifiedAt`
(§3), `version`/`_renderVersion` (§2), and `id`/`ifcData.guid`/authored geometry/authored
provenance (§1) — `createdBy` appears nowhere in the ADR, and it is the ONLY member of the
`Metadata` block that no class mentions. That is a GAP IN THE GOVERNANCE ACT, not a defect in
the comparator, and closing it is an ADR amendment rather than a code change. It is left
OPEN rather than guessed, because the two plausible readings differ materially:
* class 1 AUTHORITATIVE — if 'ai' vs 'user' is authored provenance, then a restore that
re-stamps it as 'system' DESTROYS the record of who authored the element. ADR-0319 §1
already places authored provenance (`detectionMethod: 'manual-*'`) in class 1, and this
reading is continuous with that. It is also the reading C75 (provenance) would favour.
* class 3 DERIVED-INCIDENTAL — if it is a bookkeeping stamp nothing reads, it belongs
beside createdAt/modifiedAt.
Assigning class 3 to a field that is really class 1 would be INVISIBLE to this gate — §3.20's
own "Cannot see" row says exactly that: a mislabelled field is caught only by the round-trip
comparator going quiet. So the honest state is UNCLASSIFIED-AND-NAMED, decided by whoever owns
ADR-0319, not silently resolved by the agent that built the gate. Guessing here would be the
tolerance-list-written-to-pass that ADR-0319's own Alternatives section rejects on process
grounds.
NOT MEASURED AS A DIVERGENCE TODAY, and that is not evidence of safety: the certification
fixture seeds elements through commands that stamp a consistent value, so createdBy does not
currently MOVE across a round-trip. It is on this ledger because it has NO RULE, not because
it failed — precisely the distinction K1b exists to draw (K1 can only see fields that
diverged; a field stable on this seed is invisible to it).
─── THE SECOND EXIT CONDITION, STATED SO NOBODY READS AN EMPTY LIST AS DONE ────────────────
Emptying this list is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT for C70 §7's exit condition. Class 1 is
not enumerated anywhere and nothing at HEAD ENFORCES it — no type, no schema brand, no runtime
check marks a field AUTHORITATIVE. "Every field carries its class" is therefore true today
only in the WEAK sense that unlisted implies class 1, which is a documented convention and not
an enforced one. The gate prints this on every run under NOT CHECKED. Until an enforcement
mechanism for class 1 exists, this gate's exit condition is UNMET even at zero entries.
SHRINK-ONLY. A name that stops being measured must be struck in the same commit that fixes it,
or check-derived-classification exits 3 STALE LEDGER. A name may only be REMOVED by giving the
field a class in ADR-0319 and adding it to the corresponding enforced list in capture.ts —
never by deleting the line.
